description: This file defines the NextWordsStorage class responsible for loading and storing next-word prediction data in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles file I/O operations, version management, and interacts with parser classes for data serialization.

classes.name: NextWordsStorage
classes.description: Manages persistent storage of next-word prediction data, including loading from and saving to internal storage, with version handling and error management.

methods.name: NextWordsStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage with context and locale-specific filename.

methods.name: loadStoredNextWords
methods.description: Loads stored next words from file, handling different versions and errors.

methods.name: storeNextWords
methods.description: Stores next words into file, with error handling and resource management.
